name: Italy
maintainer: Reference module — renewable-energy developer, Campania (BESS pipeline)

regulator.name: ARERA
regulator.role: Energy regulator: market rules, tariffs, grid-code & connection rules (TICA)

tso.name: Terna
tso.role: Transmission System Operator: HV grid, STMG, MACSE, Capacity Market

dso.name: e-distribuzione
dso.role: Largest Distribution System Operator: MV/LV connections

ministry.name: MASE
ministry.role: Ministry of Environment & Energy Security: single-authorization for standalone BESS (DG-FTA Div. IV)

incentiveAgency.name: GSE
incentiveAgency.role: Manages incentive schemes (FER, auctions, guarantees of origin)

MACSE.full: Meccanismo di Approvvigionamento di Capacità di Stoccaggio Elettrico
MACSE.desc: 15-year tolling contract with Terna for new electricity storage. First auction (Sept 2025) procured 10 GWh with delivery from 2028; owners may keep a share of capacity for merchant upside.
MACSE.source: Terna; Decreto MASE 9 luglio 2024 n.190; ARERA Del. 247/2023/R/eel

capacityMarket.desc: Annual reliability auction run by Terna ~T-2. Feb 2025 new-capacity clearing ≈ €47,000/MW/year; storage derated by duration.

merchant.desc: Energy arbitrage on MGP/MI plus ancillary-services revenue on the MSD/Dispatching market. Highest upside, highest risk.

FER.desc: Incentive framework for renewable generation under D.Lgs 199/2021 (RED II transposition), administered by GSE.

standaloneBESS.authority: MASE — DG-FTA, Division IV (Sicily: Service 3, Regional Energy Dept.)
standaloneBESS.portal: MASE single-authorization online portal, live from 2 Dec 2024
standaloneBESS.eiaNote: Standalone electrochemical BESS generally NOT subject to VIA/EIA under D.Lgs 152/2006 when sited in qualifying areas (e.g. ≥300 MWth fossil sites, or non-industrial areas per art.1(2)(b) D.L. 7/2002).
standaloneBESS.source: MASE Operational Guidelines (16 Apr 2024); ess-news 12 Nov 2024

regionalPAUR.desc: Regional single authorization combining VIA + Autorizzazione Unica when environmental assessment is triggered (e.g. co-located generation, or by size/sensitivity).

grid.saturation: The HV grid in Southern Italy is heavily saturated; a binding answer requires Terna's STMG, not the preliminary estimate.
grid.stmg: STMG (Soluzione Tecnica Minima Generale) = Terna's binding minimum general technical solution defining connection works, voltage, point of connection and costs.
grid.voltageDefault: 150 kV (HV) typical for ≥10 MW storage; MV fallback via e-distribuzione
grid.source: Terna grid code; ARERA TICA art.20 (STMG)

finance.note: Defaults reflect 2025 Italian LFP turnkey costs and a MACSE-tolled + merchant revenue stack for a 4h system. Override per project.

refNorms.what: RED II transposition — FER incentives framework
